name: dsh-opencode-palette
description: DSH Web 多主题引擎：完整支持 opencode 全部 38 个主题（37 内置：33 TUI + 4 桌面 2.0 + system）。数据驱动三层管线：主题 JSON → 颜色解析 → DSH 适配注入。

scripts.deps:sync: npm update dsh-plugin-update dsh-log --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org && node scripts/check-deps.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/check-deps.ts && node scripts/inline-fonts.ts && npm run build:artifacts
scripts.test: node --test tests/engine.test.ts tests/float-geometry.test.ts tests/panel-render.test.ts tests/update-panel.test.ts tests/log-switch.test.ts tests/release-scripts.test.ts tests/sync-verify.test.ts tests/readme-head-tail.test.ts tests/readme-body.test.ts tests/terminology.test.ts tests/star-history.test.ts tests/verify-thanks-table.ts tests/group-boundary.test.ts tests/custom-themes-storage.test.ts tests/custom-editor.test.ts tests/custom-theme.test.ts tests/ip-presets.test.ts tests/source-parser.test.ts
